About me

Hi, I'm Raymond.

I'm an ASA-credentialed actuary and consultant, currently one exam away from my FSA. Day to day, I work on reserving, pricing, and IFRS 17 across Southeast Asian markets — so the material I tutor is the same material I use professionally, not something I studied once and set aside.

Since 2021, I've tutored candidates through every SOA associate exam — P, FM, FAM, ASTAM, ALTAM, SRM, and PA. I know how tempting it is to memorize a formula the night before an exam, and I know how much better it goes when you actually understand why it works. That's the difference I try to build into every session.

How we work

Two things happen in every session.

First

Understand the concept

We slow down on the material until it actually clicks — why the formula looks the way it does, not just what it says. Memorizing gets you through one question. Understanding gets you through the exam.

→
Then

Work through it together

We solve practice questions side by side. Watching how you approach a problem tells me exactly where you're getting stuck — and lets me share how to think about it under real exam conditions.

Simple, hourly rates.

Personal

  • Live teaching, one-on-one

Group
$75 / hour

Small groups, up to 4 candidates, split the hour together.

  • Live teaching, up to 4 people
  • Slide deck covering the material

WhatsApp group support included. Every candidate I work with gets added to a WhatsApp group — if something comes up between sessions, a concept that's not sitting right or a practice question you're stuck on, you can raise it there any time.
Mock exams

Find out how ready you really are.

A timed, graded mock exam built specifically to test your exam-readiness — not to make you feel good. I deliberately load it with tricky, challenging questions instead of easy ones, so it feels harder than the real exam.

A rough score is normal — that's the point. This is a diagnostic, built to surface exactly where your understanding breaks down before it costs you on exam day.

Built harder than the real thing, on purpose
1

Take it timed, on your own

Full-syllabus, exam conditions, no shortcuts.

2

Write out your thought process

On paper — not just the final answer, so I can see how you actually got there.

3

Send me your timed answers

Along with your working, for every question.

4

I grade it and give real feedback

Not just right or wrong — exactly where each miss happened, and why, so you know precisely what to drill before the real exam.
